dedupe_keys.name: 地下水水位觀測井井況 sewerage and wastewater and flood

description: 地下水水位觀測井井況 [sewerage and wastewater and flood] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 本資料集係經濟部水利署於全台各地下水區設置之地下水觀測站井井況資料，其中包含觀測井井號、設置位置、坐標、井深、井頂高、所屬地下水分區、地下水分層、開始觀測日期及廢站日期等基本資訊，除了解全台地下水觀測井分布及設置概況外，可配合各觀測井水位資料，進一步分析區域地下水文情勢。 其中，本資料集之井頂高資料係指觀測井井口高程資料，其仍可能因地層下... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
